title: RAG Retrieval Pipeline Plan
description: A structured retrieval-side RAG design (chunking, hybrid mode, rerank, eval, freshness), so this skill's fixed order of work and Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/rag_retrieval_pattern_design_audit.mjs.

chunkStrategy.description: The chunking strategy. Recursive at ~512 tokens is the documented baseline.

chunkSizeTokens.description: Target chunk size in tokens. ~512 is the baseline; > 2048 dilutes, < 128 loses context.

chunkOverlapPct.description: Chunk overlap as a percentage of chunk size. 10-20% is the documented band.

semanticProvenBetter.description: True if semantic chunking has been shown to beat recursive on this corpus's own eval set (required when chunkStrategy is semantic).

retrievalMode.description: The retrieval architecture. hybrid-rrf (BM25 + dense fused with RRF) is the standard.

rrfK.description: The RRF constant when retrievalMode is hybrid-rrf. Conventional value: 60.

preRerankTopK.description: Candidates retrieved before reranking. Documented sweet spot: 20.

rerankerPresent.description: True if a cross-encoder reranker sits between retrieval and the LLM.

postRerankTopK.description: Chunks passed to the LLM after reranking. Standard: 5. Must not exceed preRerankTopK.

evalSetSize.description: Number of hand-curated eval questions with ground truth. Quality gate: 100+.

ragasInCi.description: True if RAGAS runs in CI and gates merges on faithfulness / context-precision regressions.

embeddingChosenByDomainEval.description: True if the embedding model was selected by MTEB-on-your-domain evaluation rather than the global leaderboard.

reindexCadence.description: How often the index is refreshed. never fails the freshness gate.

zeroResultRateMonitored.description: True if the zero-result rate is measured and alerted (warn > 5%, critical > 15%).

perQueryLoggingStructured.description: True if every query logs candidates+scores per retriever, rerank scores, final top-5, and latency.
